zusammenfassung: Paul hasn’t slept for two nights and finds a new postcard in his coat pocket, which he only turns over at the fish stall: “Why didn’t you come?” At home a withheld number calls, nobody speaks. Today is Thursday.
wendung: The second postcard and the silent call.
antagonistenBezug: Consortium? Possible traces: “Kranich”, radio report about empty granaries.
